description:
List a team's delivery cycles, oldest first: number, label, startDate, endDate, state (ended, active or future), isCurrent, locked and lockReason (started, or signed_off for a cycle whose plan was signed off), openReason (not_signed_off for a started cycle that is open because its team locks only at sign-off), committed (initiatives, workItems, openWorkItems and demandDays, as the Cycles board counts them) and capacity (availableDays over the cycle's own window). currentCycleNumber names the cycle containing today. By default 2 ended cycles, the current one and the next 3.

Cycle numbers count on a team's own cadence, and teams can run different cadences. To plan a work item into a cycle: read the item's team (team.id from anyforge_get_work_item), list that team's cycles, pick a cycle with locked: false, then call anyforge_update_work_item with action='set-cycle' and that number as committedCycleNumber. An item with no team uses the workspace cadence: leave team out. A locked cycle (the current cycle, and any future cycle signed off early) takes or loses work only through a scope change on the Cycles board; an ended cycle takes none. A team whose cycles lock only at sign-off (cadence.lockMode 'sign_off') keeps its current cycle unlocked until its plan is signed off, so set-cycle can add to it. Without a team, teamCadences lists the teams on a cadence of their own, whose numbers are not these.

ahead.description: Future cycles after the current one, 0–6 (default 3).

past.description: Ended cycles before the current one, 0–12 (default 2).

team.description: A team slug (a work item's team.id). Its subteams' work counts too. Left out: the workspace cadence. An unknown slug is refused (unknown_team).

name: anyforge_list_cycles
title: List cycles
